name: Erle Goldschmidt
original_name: エーレ・ゴルトシュミット
source:
Commander of the Second Company, under the Imperial Army. Said to be [url=/c156180]Duke Brown[/url]'s left arm.
She acts like an old-school detached force, and mostly gets sent out on sneak attacks, or to lead pincer strikes.

[From Digital Artwork book]
